clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Honorary Picks are prepared for Brock Stoneseeker’s mining apprentices in Thelsamar. Gryphons carry them to Loch Modan, where the ceremonial tools mark students ready to work its ore veins.

Mining keeps the great forges burning and supplies dwarves with iron and stone. In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker teaches young apprentices to mine. Honorary Picks from Ironforge recognize students ready to work the open ore deposits across Loch Modan.

The picks travel through the Alliance gryphon network, linking Ironforge with its outlying settlements. Gryth Thurden receives the shipment at Ironforge’s Great Forge and sends it over the mountains to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.
